name: Caro-Kann Defense
description: A rock-solid answer to 1.e4. Prepare ...d5 with ...c6, and get your light-squared bishop out before ...e6 locks it in. Fewer tactics and healthy pawns.

lessons.title: Classical: bishop to f5
lessons.summary: Get your bishop out, then meet White's h-pawn push calmly.

moves.note: The Caro-Kann: prepare ...d5 with pawn support.
Take the pawn to free your position.
The key idea: develop the bishop with tempo, before playing ...e6.
Retreat, but keep the bishop on its strong diagonal.
White threatens h5 to trap your bishop.
Make room, so the bishop can drop back to h7.
The knight on d7 stops Ne5 and supports ...Ngf6 later.
Tuck the bishop away on h7. It still aims at White's queenside.

lessons.title: Advance Variation
lessons.summary: Bishop out first, then attack White's pawn chain with ...c5.

moves.note: White grabs space and locks the center.
Develop the bishop outside the pawn chain before ...e6.
Now ...e6 is fine, because your bishop is already out.
Hit the base of White's pawn chain. Moving the c-pawn twice is worth it here.
The queen joins the attack on d4 and also eyes b2.

lessons.title: Exchange Variation
lessons.summary: When White trades on d5, develop actively and guard b7.

moves.note: The Exchange Variation: White releases the tension.
Recapture with the c-pawn and keep a pawn in the center.
White's bishop aims at your kingside.
Develop, and guard h7 from White's bishop.
White's other bishop comes out actively.
Develop with tempo by attacking White's queen.
White's queen escapes and attacks b7 at the same time.
Defend b7 calmly. You're well developed and the game is equal.

lessons.title: Two Knights Variation
lessons.summary: Trade your bishop for the knight, then simplify.

moves.note: White develops before deciding on d4.
The Two Knights: White brings out both knights.
Pin the knight against White's queen.
White asks the bishop what it wants to do.
Trade the bishop for the knight instead of retreating.
Support d5 and open a path for your other bishop.
Develop and add pressure on e4.
Trade knights to reduce White's attacking chances.
Develop your last knight, ready for ...Nf6 with tempo on the queen.
